Form 63
591
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPARTMENT.
C. : D
I. O. REC
No....... 591
Date.... 21/9/16
STATEMENT.
Central, 21/9/16. 191
Loo Tuh Kwen (羅德貴 ) 34, Hweichow, Houseboy, lately
employed by Mr. Morscher, states:-
I have been a "boy" in the employ of Mr. Morscher for the
past 17 months. During that time Morscher stayed at different
times at the German Club, Kalee Hotel, Quinsan Gardens, and Mr.
Thomsen's house in Yu Yuen Road.
On the 9th inst. Morscher left Shanghai and I went to stay
with a friend in the "boys' quarters" of the Kalee Hotel. During
the month of March, whilst Morscher was staying in the Kalee, I
became acquainted with Fromm, and also Nielsen, whose house in
Frenchtown had been destroyed by fire.
When Morscher left Shanghai, Fromm asked me if I would be his
"boy" in a new house beginning on the 1st of the next month. I
agreed.
On the 19th inst. about 4 p.m. I was in the bar of the Astor
Grill, when Fromm came in and told me to meet him outside
Neumann's Restaurant at 9.50 p.m.
I went there at 9.50 p.m. and asked the watchman if Fromm had
arrived. He replied that he had not. I waited outside for about
15 minutes when a large black motor car, driven by a foreigner
whom I did not know, drove up, from the direction of Tiendong
Road. The occupants of the car besides the driver, were Fromm,
Nielsen and a young foreign woman.
Nielsen and Fromm told me to get into the car which I did
and sat down alongside the driver. The car then proceeded over
the Garden Bridge, along the Bund, Hankow, Szechuen and Canton
Roads and pulled up at Canton and Shantung Road corner. Nielsen
and Fromm got out and told me to get out also. I noticed the
latter take a brown paper parcel from a locker in the car.
The two of them walked West along Canton Road a short distance

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
刑事调查科。
C. : D
I. O. REC
编号....... 591
日期.... 1916年9月21日
陈述书。
中央捕房，1916年9月21日。191
Loo Tuh Kwen（羅德貴），34岁，徽州人，男仆，近期受雇于 Morscher 先生，陈述如下：
我在过去17个月里一直担任 Morscher 先生的“男仆”。在此期间，Morscher 曾先后寓居德国总会、卡利饭店（Kalee Hotel）、昆山路花园（Quinsan Gardens）以及汤姆森（Thomsen）先生位于愚园路的宅邸。
本月9日，Morscher 离开上海，我便搬去卡利饭店的“仆人宿舍”与一位朋友同住。在三月份，当 Morscher 住在卡利饭店期间，我结识了 Fromm，以及 Nielsen，后者在法租界的住宅曾遭火灾焚毁。
当 Morscher 离开上海后，Fromm 问我是否愿意从下个月1日起，在一所新宅邸中做他的“男仆”。我答应了。
本月19日下午4点左右，我正在阿斯特烧烤餐厅（Astor Grill）的酒吧间，这时 Fromm 进来，让我晚上9点50分在诺伊曼餐厅（Neumann's Restaurant）外与他见面。
我于晚上9点50分到达那里，并询问守夜人 Fromm 是否已到。他回答说没有。我在外面等了大约15分钟，这时一辆大型黑色汽车从天潼路方向驶来，司机是一名我不认识的外国人。除司机外，车上乘客还有 Fromm、Nielsen 和一名年轻的外国女子。
Nielsen 和 Fromm 让我上车，我便上了车，坐在司机旁边。随后，汽车驶过外白渡桥，沿外滩、汉口路、四川路和广东路行驶，并在广东路与山东路路口停下。Nielsen 和 Fromm 下车，并让我也下车。我注意到后者从车内的储物柜中取出一个棕色纸包裹。
他们两人沿广东路向西走了一小段距离
